arStrings.szText: The pilgrims Bnatros and Adoné have learned that spreading their faith to the Askari is no easy task.
Bnatros and I reached the Lycander ruin, but all we have found so far is carnage. Morlu have overrun the site, and Adoné may be in danger. I must find her.
